title: Infer resolution step types and apply re-applications in place in Lean
summary: Lean reconstruction now omits the stated type of unit resolution steps and writes one-use re-applications in place, shrinking QF_IDL DTP_k2_n35_c245_s9 from 26.1 to 23.2 MB of Lean and its peak memory from 7.86 to 7.45 GB under the 8 GB cap.
